scenes.text: That funky smell from your aligners? Avoid it this way.
Cleaning your aligners is super important.

scenes.heading: Cleaning Tips
items: Rinse aligners with water after eating.
Use a soft toothbrush and mild soap.
Avoid using toothpaste, it can scratch.
Soak them in a gentle cleaner occasionally.

scenes.text: These steps can help keep your aligners fresh.
